jobs.occupation: Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters
jobs.description:
Product Management at Dalux – Turning Information into Attention

Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

About You

You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

• Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.

• Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.

• Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.

• Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.

• Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.

• Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.

• Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

What To Expect At Dalux

At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

Ready for the next step?

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

About Dalux

Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

Application deadline:

As soon as possible

About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

As Director, Application Management, you'll build the capabilities Hemab needs to run its business and regulated systems reliably as we grow. Working within IT & Digital, you'll take ownership from solution selection through implementation and ongoing management, making sure technology works for the people who depend on it.

You'll have room to shape how Application Management works at Hemab, deciding what we need now, what can wait and where external partners make more sense than building internally.

What you'll do

• Lead business system implementations from business case and solution selection through go-live, adoption and ongoing management.

• Turn business needs into practical technology solutions that fit Hemab's priorities, architecture and stage of growth.

• Own vendor selection, including RFI/RFP activities, solution evaluation and recommendations.

• Manage implementation partners and application vendors, holding them accountable for delivery, quality and service.

• Work with business owners to make sure systems, controls, training and ways of working are ready before launch.

• Establish application lifecycle management covering performance, upgrades, changes, renewals and vendor relationships.

• Partner with System Owners and Quality to keep regulated and GxP applications compliant and appropriately controlled.

• Build change and release management capabilities, using external specialists where appropriate.

• Work across Quality, Information Security, Data & AI, Legal and IT Operations to make sound technology decisions and build internal capabilities as Hemab grows.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Experience leading enterprise application implementations from selection through adoption and ongoing management.

• Experience working with regulated systems in biotech, pharma or another regulated life-sciences environment.

• Practical knowledge of GxP requirements, system lifecycle management and the controls needed to maintain compliance.

• Experience managing application vendors, implementation partners and outsourced services.

• Evidence of delivering complex, cross-functional technology projects while managing competing business needs.

• Ability to work with senior stakeholders, make clear recommendations and take accountability for delivery.

Nice to have

• Experience helping a biotech scale from early clinical development towards later-stage maturity.

• Experience building an Application Management function or introducing new ways of working.

• Experience establishing change and release management using external partners.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. Whoever takes this role will likely build some of their own process instead of inheriting a finished one. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

This is the actual shape of working somewhere at this stage: It's genuinely energising for the right person and genuinely frustrating for the wrong one. If you want a place where the operating manual is already written, this might not be it – but if you want to help write it, this might be exactly it.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with the structures behind fair and competitive pay? And would you like to take ownership of how job architecture, salary structures and Reward practices work across countries and entities?

This is your opportunity to take ownership of key Reward frameworks and help us mature how we work with Reward across ABENA.

As our new Global Reward Specialist, you will take ownership of key areas of our global Reward approach across countries and entities, from job architecture, salary structures and benchmarking to pay equity and Pay Transparency.

It is a role for someone who enjoys both the detail and the bigger picture: working hands-on with Reward data and frameworks while helping HR and leaders make consistent, well-informed decisions and building robust business processes.

And you will not be starting from a blank page. Important foundations are already in place. Your role is to take them further: strengthen our Reward framework, mature our approach to Pay Transparency, and turn structures and data into robust global reward practices that support consistent and well-informed decisions across ABENA.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Own and further develop ABENA’s reward framework, including pay policy, salary and bonus structures, pay ranges and related governance.

• Own and continuously improve our global job architecture, ensuring consistent job evaluation, levels and career paths across the organization.

• Drive and mature our Pay Transparency efforts, including pay equity analyses, pay-gap reporting, related governance and long-term compliance.

• Lead relevant recurring reward processes such as annual salary reviews and compensation analyses.

• Turn reward data into clear recommendations supporting pay decisions, internal equity and competitiveness.

• Advise HR and leaders on reward decisions, job leveling, promotions, new roles and organizational changes.

• Develop communication, training and guidance materials that strengthen reward capabilities and ensure consistent understanding and application of reward principles across ABENA.

What we are looking for

• A proven track record working within Reward, Compensation & Benefits, ideally from an international organization.

• Hands-on experience with job architecture, job evaluation, salary structures, and compensation.

• Strong knowledge of pay equity and EU Pay Transparency, with the ability to turn requirements into practical processes and governance.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate compensation data into clear insights and recommendations.

• A pragmatic and hands-on approach, with the confidence to advise and challenge HR colleagues and leaders across countries and functions.

• Strong Excel and HR systems understanding, together with fluent English and Danish.

Your Team, Our Culture and Values

You will join our Group HR team, working alongside experienced HR specialists and generalists who work closely together, share ideas, and use each other’s different perspectives and expertise. Even when things are busy, we make room for laughter and a good atmosphere. We value collaboration and openness. For us, it is important that we support one another, and that it is genuinely enjoyable to come to work. Creating and maintaining a positive atmosphere and a great team spirit is something we are all responsible for.

Your leader at ABENA will be Lotte Blanner, HR Director, who describes her leadership style as follows:

“Trust and clear direction. I actively seek and value your input in our shared work, and I listen to your ambitions so I can support both your tasks and your development through honest feedback and clear priorities. I value people who take ownership and show initiative. You can count on me to stand by you and back you up along the way. We aim high but set realistic ambitions and take a pragmatic approach to the realities we work within”

At ABENA, you become part of a global company with a clear purpose: making a real difference in people’s everyday lives. Across the organization, we are guided by three core values: Trust, Fairness, and Cooperation. They shape how we work together, make decisions, and take responsibility for moving ABENA forward.

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsels for Legal & Compliance department at Novo Nordisk Engineering

Legal Counsels for Legal & Compliance department at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you’re energised by varied legal and compliance work and you thrive on supporting some of the world’s largest pharma engineering projects, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for two Legal Counsels to join our Legal & Compliance team in Virum, Denmark. You will join a small, dedicated team of colleagues who daily provides timely, commercially relevant legal and compliance advice that enables our line of business to deliver complex engineering projects.

Your role is key in ensuring that NNE navigates complex legal, contractual, and compliance matters effectively, while supporting our colleagues and projects across Denmark, India, and the US. You will report directly to the General Counsel, who heads the Legal & Compliance team globally.

This is a generalist, hands-on role where your time split roughly equally between legal and compliance work. You will see the practical impact of your advice across the organisation, and you will be given responsibility from the outset, while working alongside experienced colleagues who will support your continued development.

If you are qualified as a Danish attorney (advokat), you can retain your practising certificate in this role.

How you might spend your days

As a Legal Counsel, you’ll be:

• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating consultancy agreements and a wide range of other commercial contracts, including supplier, software, framework and data processing agreements

• Advising projects on contractual matters, change orders and claims

• Driving key elements of our compliance programme across business ethics, data protection, confidentiality and AI governance, including internal audits

• Developing and maintaining legal and compliance policies, standards and procedures

• Delivering training and awareness activities across the business

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Taking ownership from the outset, act proactively and look for solutions.

• Collaborating effectively across projects, disciplines and geographies. You build strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders across the organisation.

• Delivering high-quality work on time and know how to prioritise when things move quickly. You balance legal requirements, business realities and risk.

• Curious, keen to learn and look for ways to improve how we work. You approach new and complex matters with an open mind and challenge constructively when needed.

• Working independently and in a structured way. Your commercial mindset and genuine interest in NNE’s business enable you to provide pragmatic and legally robust advice.

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• A master’s degree in law (cand.jur.) or business law (cand.merc.jur.) or an equivalent legal qualification

• Around 3-5 years of experience from a law firm and/or an in-house legal function

• A broad legal foundation and an interest in working across different areas of law and compliance

• Excellent written and spoken English

• A responsible, curious approach to AI and new technology.

Life at NNE.

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 22 November 2026.

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact General Counsel Maj-Britt Nedergaard Larsen at +45 30 77 45 63 to arrange a call.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

Location: Central Copenhagen; primarily in office

Language: English

**Highlights

**

• Full-Stack Python/TS engineer needed for a B2B SaaS startup in Copenhagen (with plenty of traction!)

• We have a lean, get-stuff-done team. No annoying extra management layers or unnecessary bureaucratic rituals. And we are "AI-forward" in our own development practices.

• You will own features end to end, from the data model through to the screen, on a platform that manufacturers rely on to keep production lines running.

• You will work in a small engineering team, directly with the person who decides what we build, and the problems you spend your time on are hard because the domain is hard, not because the organization is.

• We're building legitimately useful tools for the industries and companies that make the world go around.... manufacturers. Both AI-tools and just "plain-old-good-software" tools.

**About Supplios

**Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality, all in a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth.

The platform now covers more ground than the team that built it. We are hiring engineers to keep that pace sustainable, and to go deeper on the parts of the product our customers are pushing hardest.

The role

You will join a small engineering team and work across the whole stack: Python on the backend, TypeScript on the frontend and in the AI layers. There is no split between people who design and people who implement. You will take a problem from a customer conversation or a product decision through to something running in production for real manufacturers.

You will work directly with our co-founder and CEO, who is a hands-on product builder himself. That means short conversations instead of tickets thrown over a wall, and it means your questions about why something should work a certain way get answered by the person who decided it.

The domain is genuinely complicated, and that is the interesting part. Supplier relationships in automotive involve deep hierarchies, long-running approval processes, strict audit requirements and a lot of state that has to be exactly right. Modeling that well is most of the job.

Title and level flex with experience. We are open to strong mid-level engineers and to senior engineers who want more scope than their current company gives them.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and on a codebase with this much implicit context, working through problems with the rest of the team in person is much faster than doing it in writing. Sensible flexibility when you need it is a given; full-time remote is not what we are offering.

**Our Current Stack

**

• Backend: Python / Django

• Frontend: Vue (but no specific Vue experience is needed)

• Infrastructure: AWS (mostly)

• Agents: Cloudflare (TypeScript) + Claude & OpenAI platform

What you will do

• Build features end to end, from data model and backend logic through to the TypeScript frontend our customers actually click on.

• Build end-to-end / front-to-back AI features (in-app AI assistants, background worker agents, email-routing agents, customer-configurable agent framework components)

• Design and evolve the relational data model that sits under supplier relationships, approvals and quality records.

• Take vaguely defined customer problems and turn them into something specific enough to build, then build it.

• Work on integrations between Supplios and customer systems (ERP and adjacent tooling), where failures have visible consequences for a production line.

• Improve the parts of the codebase that need it, rather than routing around them.

• Review other people's code and have yours reviewed; we keep the loop tight and unbureaucratic.

• Help keep the platform healthy in production across our regions: errors, performance and the boring things that keep customers trusting us.

• Take part in product decisions. Engineers here are expected to have opinions about what we build, not just how.

What we are looking for

**Essential

**

• Professional experience with Python. This is not negotiable; the backend is Python and you need to be effective in it.

• Solid TypeScript experience and genuine comfort working on the frontend.

• Experience building and running SaaS products, including the part after launch where real users depend on them.

• AI-forward development techniques. (This does not mean you no longer write code.)

• A track record of owning work end to end without waiting to be told what to do next.

• The temperament for a small, senior company: high ownership, low ceremony.

• You want to work primarily from an office in central Copenhagen, with a small team.

**Nice to have

**Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. Nobody has all of these.

• Experience with B2B enterprise SaaS, especially where customers are large and demanding and implementations are not self-serve. This is a significant plus.

• Experience with complex relational data modeling, and with large, long-lived codebases that you did not write yourself. A big plus.

• Experience building AI-based products, using the latest frameworks/harnesses and infrastructure components (including RAG) is a significant plus.

• Familiarity with any of: domain-driven design, the actor model, finite state machines, CQRS, event-driven architecture. We use these ideas where they earn their place, and it helps if the vocabulary is already yours.

• Startup experience, particularly early stage. A significant plus.

• Knowledge of manufacturing, automotive or supply chain. Useful, but we can teach you the domain; we cannot teach you the craft, so do not rule yourself out on this.

**Language

**English is the only important language for this position; we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• The scope is unusually large for the stage. You are one of a small number of engineers on a platform that serves demanding customers globally. What you build ships, and it ships soon.

• No layers between you and the decisions. You work directly with the co-founder and CEO, who runs product. There is no committee to navigate and nobody to translate your work for you.

• Hard problems that are not artificially hard. The complexity comes from the domain (hierarchies, state, audit trails, integrations that must not fail), not from organisational overhead.

• Real customers already, and real gaps. The product has paying customers in automotive and clear places where it needs to get better. Both halves of that are true, and both are why this is a good job.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced downstream technician with hands-on knowledge of chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes? Do you enjoy working independently while sharing your expertise with colleagues?

**At AGC Biologics, we are looking for a Senior Technician to join our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing team in Copenhagen.

You will work in a dynamic, GMP-regulated manufacturing environment where different products and customer requirements call for technical expertise, adaptability, and attention to detail. As part of the team, you will contribute to reliable production while helping strengthen the technical capabilities of your colleagues.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Technician, you will be responsible for executing downstream purification processes and ensuring that manufacturing activities are carried out safely, efficiently, and in compliance with GMP requirements.

You will work independently within your area of expertise while collaborating with colleagues to meet production goals. The role requires strong process understanding, sound judgement, and the ability to adapt to different manufacturing setups without compromising quality.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Executing downstream purification processes, including chromatography, filtration, and ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF).

• Operating chromatography systems, including UNICORN software, and applying your technical understanding during production.

• Ensuring accurate GMP documentation and compliance with approved procedures and aseptic practices.

• Supporting troubleshooting, deviation investigations, and continuous improvement activities.

• Taking ownership of your training, technical qualifications, and development.

• Sharing knowledge and providing hands-on training and guidance to less experienced colleagues.

As you become familiar with our processes, we expect you to take an active role in supporting the development of new colleagues and contributing to high standards of technical performance and GMP behaviour within the team.

**Who Are We Looking For?

**We are looking for an experienced technician with a solid understanding of downstream purification and a strong commitment to quality and compliance.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Have approximately 3–5 years of experience in GMP-regulated manufacturing, preferably within biopharmaceutical production.

• Have an educational background as a Process Operator, Industrial Technician, Biotechnology Technician, or an equivalent relevant technical qualification.

• Have hands-on experience with chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes.

• Have a good understanding of UNICORN chromatography systems.

• Are familiar with GMP requirements, aseptic practices, and accurate production documentation.

• Can independently execute complex manufacturing activities and contribute to solving technical challenges.

Beyond your technical experience, we value colleagues who take ownership of their work and development, maintain high standards of quality, and contribute positively to the team.

You work in a structured way, adapt to changing production needs, and willingly share your knowledge. You communicate openly and understand when to ask for support or escalate an issue rather than compromise quality or compliance.

**Working Hours

**This is a night-shift position (18:00-05:04 or 20:00-07:04) in our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing department in Copenhagen.

You will work according to an established shift schedule (5-2 in a 14 days period) supporting our manufacturing operations.

**What We Offer

**At AGC Biologics, you will join an international biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment where technical expertise, accountability, quality, and teamwork are central to how we work.

**We Offer

**

• The opportunity to work with different products and downstream manufacturing setups, developing your technical expertise.

• A role where your experience matters, both in daily production and in supporting the development of your colleagues.

• A supportive and approachable manager who values trust, accountability, and open communication.

• A collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are encouraged.

• We offer an attractive compensation and benefits package, including pension, health insurance, and other benefits in accordance with local agreements.

• Access to our canteen arrangement, Employee Club, and employee discount opportunities.

**Interested?

**If you have experience with downstream purification and are motivated by combining technical responsibility with quality and teamwork, we would like to hear from you.

Interested?

Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we reserve the right to close the job posting once we have found the right candidate.

**Apply today and join our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing team at AGC Biologics.

****Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

**Job Description

**_Would you like to use your property management experience to help develop solutions that create real value? As a Property Manager at Netcompany, you will work with technical teams and customers to turn real-life experience into solutions that improve property management through a data driven approach that ensure the right usage of AI and digital capabilities.

_**Responsibilities

**Netcompany is looking for a Property Manager to take a key role in the continued development of our property management solutions. The role is for an experienced, operational property manager who knows the reality of managing properties day to day and can use that experience to help shape better digital solutions. You will bring hands-on knowledge of property management into the product development process and work closely with technical and refinement teams to ensure that solutions reflect real-life processes, challenges and user needs. You will also contribute to customer dialogue, where your practical experience helps create credibility and a strong understanding of how the product can support customers in their daily work.

A significant part of the role involves leveraging your property management experience in product improvements, customer insight and relevant market activities. You will participate in customer meetings, support pre-sales activities and contribute to business development through market dialogue and feedback from existing and potential customers. This is not a sales role; your contribution is your professional expertise and ability to understand the customer's operational reality, ask the right questions and help connect their needs with the capabilities of the product.

**Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include

**

• Ensuring the product delivers value, automation potential and efficiency across the property management value chain

• Working closely with the technical team and refinement team on product development

• Supporting business development and sales activities through market dialogue, customer feedback and pre-sales activities

• Participating in customer meetings and other client-facing activities

• Building trust and credibility in customer dialogues

**About You

**To succeed in this role, you:

• Have solid operational experience working as a property manager

• Contribute with operational experience across a property portfolio, including the full complexity of Danish regulatory requirements (eg. cost control rent 'OMK', free market rent, taxes, duties and rates, operational budgets)

• Have experience across residential, commercial and mixed properties including the customer reporting requirements a property manager faces

• Have experience as a power user or super user of a property management software system

• Have full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

**Continue developing with us

**At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

**Join an inclusive community

**At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

**Send us an application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Are you a people-focused leader who enjoys creating structure, solving challenges, and improving the way things work? Do you thrive on building a strong team spirit and helping people perform at their best?

If so, you may be our new Quality Team Leader at NORMAL’s warehouse in Hedensted.

**About The Role

**As Quality Team Leader, you will lead and support the Quality Team across both day and evening shifts. Your leadership skills, ability to motivate others, and focus on continuous improvement will be key to your success.

You will set a clear direction for the team, develop employees, improve processes, and ensure smooth communication between shifts and departments. You will also work closely with colleagues and stakeholders across the organization to maintain and improve the quality standards delivered to our stores and warehouse.

Experience from logistics or warehousing is an advantage, but it is not essential. What matters most is your ability to lead, communicate clearly, and bring out the best in people.

At NORMAL, we believe in trust, open communication, and teamwork. In this role, you will help create a positive and supportive workplace where people feel valued, take ownership, and are encouraged to do their best every day.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Lead, support, and develop the Quality Team.

• Motivate and develop employees through clear communication, coaching, feedback, and encouragement.

• Plan daily operations and coordinate staffing and schedules.

• Recruiting the right talent and build a strong team.

• Identify opportunities for improvement and implement practical, effective solutions.

• Ensure a smooth transition and strong communication between day and evening shift.

• Collaborate with warehouse departments to ensure efficient and seamless operations.

• Maintain an ongoing dialogue with internal and external stakeholders about quality standards we deliver to our stores and improvement opportunities.

• Follow up on quality performance, safety, and compliance with company standards.

• Lead by example and step in to support the team when needed.

**About You

**You are motivated by seeing your team succeed and believe that a strong team spirit leads to great results. You are approachable, organized, and structured in your way of working, while also being willing to roll up your sleeves and help when needed.

You remain calm and focused when things get busy, communicate clearly, and know how to keep people engaged. You bring a proactive, positive, and people-focused attitude to your work – and you genuinely care about your team and the results you achieve together.

**We Expect That You

**

• Have experience leading a team, preferably within warehousing or logistics.

• Communicate confidently in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Are flexible and able to support the team across both day and evening shifts.

• Are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

**It Is An Advantage If You

**

• Have experience working with a Warehouse Management System or similar tools.

• Have experience working with ERP-systems.

• Are familiar with SQL or other database structures.

**Why join NORMAL A/S?

****At NORMAL, You Will Get

**

• The opportunity to make a real impact on our growing operations.

• A down-to-earth workplace where people work together and ideas are heard.

• A role with responsibility, variety, and influence.

• Opportunities to develop your skills and grow your career.

• The chance to lead a committed team and help create a positive working environment.

If you enjoy leading by example, creating positive energy, and achieving great results through people, we would love to hear from you.

**Location and working hours

**

• Location: NORMAL’s warehouse in Hedensted

• Employment: Full-time, 37 hours per week

• Working hours: A balanced schedule supporting both:

• Day shift: 07:00–15:00

• Evening shift: 15:00–23:00

**Ready to Apply?

**We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us your application as soon as possible. The position will remain open until we have found the right candidate.

**Questions?

**If you have any questions about the position, please contact:

**Kirsten Marie Ravn

**Planning & Quality Manager

kira@normal.dk

**About TrackSights & Your Role

**Every day, thousands of used cars change hands between traders, dealer groups and leasing companies across Europe, and most of those decisions are still made on gut feeling, spreadsheets and phone calls. TrackSights changes that. We turn live market, VIN, government, proprietary and other data into instant, trusted answers on what a car is worth, where it sells fastest and what it will return, so B2B traders, sourcing departments and remarketing teams can price, source and sell with confidence. And with every user we welcome, we're steadily building a network of trusted professional B2B players across Europe's automotive trade, a network our product roadmap is designed to bring closer together.

We started in 2025 and are already used across Europe, backed by Maki.vc and Cox Automotive, one of the world's largest automotive services companies. The product works, users stay and renew, and the sales playbook is proven: the founders have closed every deal themselves. That's exactly the problem worth having. Inbound is arriving, we're welcoming new users from all over Europe, and the founders can't be the whole sales team anymore.

So we're building one. This is the moment where TrackSights goes from founder-led sales to a commercial organisation, and from a Nordic start to the trusted data and insights partner for the used-car trade across Europe. You'd be joining at the start of that, taking over outbound and helping turn traction into real growth.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Originate & own deals end-to-end: prospecting, demo, negotiation, close, handover to Customer Success

• Handle SME sales to traders, sourcing and remarketing teams across our ICP in Europe, with no single-country focus, but a strong ICP focus

• Book your own meetings through consistent outbound: phone, LinkedIn, email, sequences in HubSpot and other relevant channels

• Build and manage your own pipeline; your numbers are shared with the team weekly/monthly

• Work with the founders on messaging, ICP and how we sell, and help improve the playbook

• Work closely with our two commercial founders and our Director of Customer Success

**You – You’re a Good Match If

**You're a self-starter and entrepreneurial go-getter who's motivated by growing sales while getting your hands dirty and owning your targets. We're building an organisation of good, kind, smart and ambitious people, with low ego, high ambitions and a can-do attitude.

Relentlessly driven to close. High outbound activity and a constant push to move deals to signature. This is our number one criterion.

• Relentlessly driven on outbound. No one hands you leads here. You build your own pipeline from week one, because without the hard outbound work there are no deals to close.

• Hungry for growth. You want to help build a company with international ambitions, and to grow your own responsibility within TrackSights as you deliver.

• Either 2–4 years in B2B or SaaS sales where you generated your own pipeline (not relying on inbound or SDRs), or a strong network and experience in the automotive B2B field plus sales experience

• A track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets

• Driven to originate your own meetings, not waiting for inbound or SDRs to book them for you

• Builder mindset: you've written your own messaging or sequences before, you test and improve how you sell, and you're comfortable when not everything is defined

• CRM discipline: HubSpot preferred; structured in follow-ups, notes and pipeline, and you use the data to improve

• High ownership and consistency: you don't wait for direction, and you do the work

• You’re ambitious and want your commercial responsibility within TrackSights to grow over time, and take on larger projects or lead a team

**Languages

**

• English (required) and preferably, but not necessarily, Danish: full professional proficiency or native

• Danish, German or Dutch: a strong plus

**Your first 90 days

**

• Days 1–30: learn and get in the game already. Get up to speed on the product, the industry, the ICPs and the sales playbook. Shadow the founders on customer calls and start contributing with outreach and building your own network, already from week one.

• Days 31–60: build pipeline. You’ve already got several meetings in the books and held several. Run your own outbound, book your own meetings, run calls and demos end to end, find your rhythm in HubSpot, and maybe close your first customer. This is ultimately how you learn.

• Days 61–90: own it. Own your pipeline from first touch to close. Your first customers start to close, and you start contributing to how we scale sales.

Clear expectations for activity and results are agreed in writing before you start, and reviewed together every week.

**Why join

**

• Join an amazing team full of good people

• Join a truly exciting growth and international journey together with ambitious people, where only you set the limits

• Real ownership and impact in a company that's building its commercial organisation now

• Work directly with founders who closed current customers and proved the playbook

• Shape how sales is done, rather than executing someone else's playbook

• Where it can go: larger accounts, new markets, strategic responsibility, and in time a leading role with people under you, if you’re up to it. An option, not a requirement

**Compensation And How We Work

**

• Competitive base salary and an uncapped, attractive commission structure, with real upside tied to performance

• Warrant programme, so it feels like your company too

• Fully remote, with the option of an office (to be agreed)

• Danish holiday standards, team offsites (the last one was in Croatia!) and other perks

• High ownership, low bureaucracy, and a strong focus on culture and team fit (we only hire good-hearted people)

**Interested?

**Send us your CV and a short voice note on why this role and TrackSights make sense for you.

We will consider applicants and hire on an ongoing basis, and conduct a structured 3–4-step interview process.

**As Training Partner, you will build the training setup for the future 25L organisation while it is still taking shape. You will identify training needs, partner with leaders and turn business challenges into practical learning that gets people ready for their roles. Your work will support onboarding and capability building as 25L moves towards the PV phase in early 2028 and running production.

**What You’ll Bring

**You bring a strong learning mindset and the ability to translate business needs into practical, impactful training.

• A relevant degree within learning science, psychology, human resources or similar – or experience from a production environment combined with a passion for learning.

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience developing training and learning activities.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholders.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership and proactively drive improvements.

• A solid quality mindset and fluent English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience developing training in a structured or regulated environment.

**What You’ll Do

**You will act as an advisor and operational partner to the business, making sure training is effective, compliant and supports performance and continuous improvement.

• Identify training needs and build the future training structure for 25L, including finalising training need analyses (TNAs) with key stakeholders.

• Act as a trusted partner to leaders, showing how training can address business challenges and support onboarding and capability building.

• Design, develop, implement and evaluate training content with stakeholders across day-to-day operations and projects.

• Deliver training on training standards, including train-the-trainer, and help develop high-quality Training Outlines (TROLs) and Job Instructions (JIs).

• Support continuous improvement and systematic problem solving together with colleagues across the organisation.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the 25L Training team in Hillerød, Denmark, where training excellence and continuous improvement are at the core. It is a small team, so you will collaborate closely and support one another in your day-to-day work.

Your closest partners will be leaders, content responsibles and your training colleagues. Together, you will make sure onboarding is effective, capability grows and the training setup can support the business as 25L moves from project phase to running production. Right now, the main focus is finalising TNAs with key stakeholders and building the training setup for the future organisation.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work close to the business, where your expertise is valued and your ownership makes a visible difference. You will be trusted to take initiative and drive improvements, and supported by a team that helps each other perform. As part of a global healthcare company, you will have opportunities to learn and develop as 25L grows.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 499,600 to DKK 734,400, corresponding to the level of the position. Placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on your skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build the training that prepares 25L for what comes next, apply for the Training Partner 25L role by 15 November2026.

For further information about the position, please contact Sr. Manager Steven B. Rødkær, SVVR@novonordisk.com.
